name: Come and Play - 4 Class Pass Special Offer
description:
# Come and Play - 4 Class Pass Special Offer

\\n

## Drum and Dance Classes (New Students Only)

\\n

Come and Play is our special offer if you have never come to a drum and dance class with us before. Learn West African Drumming and Dancing every Tuesday night from 5.30pm-7.30pm. A range of different drum and dance classes for everyone.

\\n

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GaSS94SQbQY&t=4s

\\n

## _Tuesdays_

\\n

**5.30pm** - Drum Class - Open Level - All Welcome

\\n

**6.30pm** - Dance Class - Open Level - All Welcome

\\n

Held at Palmwoods Hall, 1 Main St, Palmwoods 4555 QLD

\\n

[Read More](/classes/) about these classes.

\\n

This purchase entitles you to attend 4 classes within 4 weeks. These passes expire after 4 weeks from your first class.

\\n

_Terms and Conditions: This special offer is non-refundable, non-transferable, and expires after 4 weeks._
